2607.29002.title: MMShopBench: A Real-Log Benchmark for Multimodal, Multi-Turn Shopping Agents
2607.29002.paper_summary: Online shoppers increasingly turn to AI shopping assistants, using images and multi-turn dialogue to express and refine product needs that are difficult to articulate in text alone. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on text-only or synthetic requests, underrepresenting complex real-world shopping requirements jointly expressed through images and language. We introduce MMShopBench, the first real-log benchmark for multimodal, multi-turn shopping agents. Built from carefully cleaned and manually annotated shopping logs, MMShopBench provides ground-truth annotations of each request's purchase intent and mandatory product requirements. Agents must infer these requirements jointly from user images and multi-turn dialogue, retrieve candidate products through image and text search, and verify that each candidate satisfies all requirements using its product images and structured attributes. We evaluate representative open-source and proprietary models using an evidence-grounded multimodal protocol and construct a companion training set for fine-tuning an open-source model. To ensure reproducible experimentation, we build an offline shopping sandbox, where fine-tuning substantially narrows the performance gap between our open-source model and leading proprietary models, demonstrating the effectiveness of our training data.
2607.29002.paper_summary_zh: 線上購物者越來越依賴AI購物助手，使用圖像和多輪對話來表達和細化難以用文字單獨表達的產品需求。<lb/>然而，現有的基準主要依賴於僅有文字或合成請求，未能充分代表通過圖像和語言共同表達的複雜現實購物需求。<lb/>我們推出了MMShopBench，這是首個針對多模態、多輪購物代理的真實日誌基準。<lb/>MMShopBench由經過仔細清理和手動標註的購物日誌構建，提供每個請求的購買意圖和必要產品需求的真實標註。<lb/>代理必須從用戶的圖像和多輪對話中共同推斷這些需求，通過圖像和文本搜索檢索候選產品，並驗證每個候選產品是否滿足所有需求，使用其產品圖像和結構化屬性。<lb/>我們使用基於證據的多模態協議評估代表性的開源和專有模型，並構建一個伴隨的訓練集以微調開源模型。<lb/>為了確保可重複的實驗，我們建立了一個離線購物沙盒，其中微調顯著縮小了我們的開源模型與領先專有模型之間的性能差距，證明了我們訓練數據的有效性。
